images.alt: Alt text: A semi-realistic anime concert scene shows a band performing under blazing stage lights while the crowd in front has collapsed into an absurd, ecstatic **human lasagna**—dozens of sweaty concertgoers piled several bodies deep in a nearly cartoony tangle of arms, legs, tattoos, hair, raised hands, and increasingly uncertain ownership of elbows. The performers continue playing above the chaos while the audience achieves Maximum Held.
